fix/stale-base-after-parent-merge.description: Recover a child's recorded base after its parent squash-merges and the forge rebuilds the child onto trunk

context.text: Trunk-only merge-base tier: trunk is append-only, so merge-base(trunk, branch) is where a trunk-parented branch's own commits begin. Non-trunk parents still fail loudly (an amended parent pushes the merge-base past the rewrite). Sync cleanup and get's replace-with-remote both go through one reconcileBase helper so the two paths agree.

sr log could render [base lost] instead of [needs restack] when resolveBase fails; not adopted — after this fix the trunk-parent case no longer exists, and the remaining non-trunk case would cost a fork-point lookup per branch on every sr log.
